title: Workspace settings screen
prompt: A team needs a workspace settings screen with profile fields, preferences, and save actions. Use the highest-level approved pattern that already describes this screen.

title: Labeled workspace field
prompt: A form needs one accessible text field for a workspace name. Choose the smallest approved building block rather than a full page recipe.

title: Empty collection state
prompt: A records page has no results yet and needs a clear explanation plus a primary create action. Prefer the page-level recipe over the primitive component when both match, because this is a complete state pattern.

title: Project search screen
prompt: A product team needs a searchable project directory with filters, results, loading, empty, and error states. Choose the highest-level approved recipe and leave its domain data and actions adaptable.

title: Manage a team directory
prompt: An operations team needs to browse and create records in a small management table. Prefer the approved page recipe that includes a create flow and observable states.

title: Customer detail screen
prompt: A support tool needs a detail screen for one customer with identity, editable fields, navigation back, and ready/error states. Choose the approved complete recipe.
